normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize Google Test JSON output by replacing time, timestamp, and stack trace values with wildcards
normalize_dict_with_transient_values: normalize a dictionary containing Google Test JSON output to remove transient run-specific information
normalize_list_of_test_results: normalize a list of Google Test JSON result objects by recursively replacing transient values
test_normalize_function: test the normalize function with a sample Google Test JSON output object
review_normalize_recursive_behavior: review the normalize function recursive handling of nested dicts and lists in JSON output
